tier_is_floored_not_waived.detail: With no tracker to author a tier label, the tier is --tier raised by classifyMechanicalMinimum(). A --tier below that floor is a hard PE2 fail naming the offending paths. The classifier is used only as a floor and never as a tier source: it is binary — every match hard-codes T1 and the reduce seeds T3 — so it can never emit T2 and cannot replace a declared tier.

skip_is_never_pass.detail: Every relaxed check reports 'skip'. A 'pass' would assert a requirement was satisfied that was never evaluated — the aggregate-conflation failure class already recorded against UTV2-1730/UTV2-1724. Mutation M2 is the control for this specific property.
